about: The watch-page offline media (design §5 S0b 素材与前置条件): not in the repository. make_media.ps1 makes them into root and checks each against sha256; the snapshots' place.json put them into a profile (run.ps1 Restore-WpProfile), which refuses a file whose hash differs.
